product_overview: TAC Express is a mission-control logistics platform for managing shipments, manifests, finance, customers, exceptions, and operations workflows. It provides a public tracking experience for customers and an authenticated ops console for staff to run daily logistics work.
core_goals: Let users sign in and access the operations dashboard
Enable staff to create, view, search, and track shipments
Enable staff to build and manage manifests with shipment scanning
Enable staff to create, issue, print, send, and reconcile invoices and payments
Enable staff to manage customers, notes, and shipment history
Enable staff to review and resolve exceptions
Enable staff to scan barcodes and monitor live scan activity
Let customers track shipments publicly by AWB
Let staff update profile and integration settings

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Operators can sign in, be redirected to protected areas, and sign out of the application.
user_flows: Navigate to /sign-in -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit sign-in form -> See redirect to /ops-console
Navigate to a protected route -> See redirect to /sign-in with a next parameter
Navigate to /sign-up -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit sign-up form -> See account creation success path
After signing in, open the user menu -> Choose sign out -> See the public sign-in screen

features.name: Paper Ops Console Dashboard
features.description: Authenticated users can view a mission-control style dashboard with KPIs, banner content, and quick actions into operational workflows.
user_flows: Navigate to /ops-console -> View banner, KPI cards, and upcoming operations summary
Navigate to /ops-console -> Open Active Shipments from the KPI area -> See the shipments list filtered to active shipments
Navigate to /ops-console -> Open In Transit from the KPI area -> See the shipments list filtered to in-transit shipments
Navigate to /ops-console -> Open Open Exceptions -> See the exceptions list
Navigate to /ops-console -> Start creating a shipment from the quick actions -> Open the shipment create flow
Navigate to /ops-console -> Start creating a manifest from the quick actions -> Open the manifest create flow
Navigate to /ops-console -> Use the sidebar navigation -> Move between platform, operations, business, and audit/report areas
Navigate to /ops-console -> Toggle the interface theme mode -> See the dashboard restyle

features.name: Shipment Management and Tracking
features.description: Staff can browse shipments, search and filter them, create new shipments, inspect shipment details, and print labels.
user_flows: Navigate to /ops-console/shipments -> View the shipments table with status tabs and search
Navigate to /ops-console/shipments -> Filter by shipment status -> See the list update to matching shipments
Navigate to /ops-console/shipments -> Search by AWB, sender, or receiver -> See matching results
Navigate to /ops-console/shipments -> Open a shipment from the list -> See the shipment detail page
Navigate to /shipments/create -> Fill sender details -> Fill receiver details -> Fill package details -> Review shipment data -> Submit shipment -> See shipment detail with a generated AWB
Navigate to /shipments/[id] -> Switch between overview, tracking, notes, files, and audit tabs -> See the corresponding shipment information
Navigate to /shipments/[id] -> Open the print label action -> See the thermal label print view
Navigate to /shipments/[id] -> Return back to the shipments list -> See the list view again

features.name: Manifest Builder and Manifest State Flow
features.description: Staff can create manifests, attach shipments by AWB scan or entry, and advance manifest status through operational states.
user_flows: Navigate to /ops-console/manifests -> View the manifests list with status filtering
Navigate to /manifests/create -> Select origin hub -> Select destination hub -> Choose transport type -> Enter flight or vehicle details -> Add optional notes -> Continue
Navigate to /manifests/create -> Scan or enter AWBs -> Attach shipments to the manifest -> See success, duplicate, or error feedback for each AWB
Navigate to /manifests/create -> Review load count and total weight -> Save as open or close and depart the manifest
Navigate to /ops-console/manifests/[id] -> View the manifest load list and totals -> See the current next action for the manifest status
Navigate to /ops-console/manifests/[id] -> Add an AWB inline on an open manifest -> See the shipment added to the manifest
Navigate to /ops-console/manifests/[id] -> Close the manifest -> Mark it departed -> Mark it arrived -> Reconcile it as the status advances

features.name: Invoice and Finance Workflows
features.description: Staff can create invoices, issue them, send them through WhatsApp, record payments, print documents, and manage invoice status.
user_flows: Navigate to /ops-console/finance -> View the invoices list with aging buckets and status filters
Navigate to /finance/create -> Choose a customer -> Select shipments -> Review charges -> Confirm invoice details -> Save the invoice
Navigate to /ops-console/finance/[id] -> Open the invoice detail page -> Review charges, taxes, balance, and payment timeline
Navigate to /ops-console/finance/[id] -> Open the WhatsApp send flow -> Choose direct or template mode -> Send the invoice message -> See message send confirmation
Navigate to /ops-console/finance/[id] -> Record a payment -> Enter amount, method, and reference -> Submit payment -> See the payment added to the timeline
Navigate to /ops-console/finance/[id] -> Mark the invoice fully paid -> See the invoice status update
Navigate to /ops-console/finance/[id] -> Cancel the invoice when allowed -> See the invoice status update
Navigate to /ops-console/finance/[id] -> Print or download the invoice PDF -> See the print view

features.name: Customer Management
features.description: Staff can view customers, edit customer profiles, add notes, and review shipment history.
user_flows: Navigate to /ops-console/customers -> View the customers list with revenue and shipment counts
Navigate to /customers/[id] -> Open a customer record -> See the full customer profile and shipment history
Navigate to /customers/[id] -> Enable edit mode -> Modify customer fields -> Save changes -> See updated customer details
Navigate to /customers/[id] -> Open the Notes tab -> Add a note -> See the note appear in the timeline
Navigate to /customers/[id] -> Delete a note -> See the note removed from the timeline

features.name: Exception Review and Resolution
features.description: Staff can review exceptions, inspect details, add resolution text, and mark exceptions resolved.
user_flows: Navigate to /ops-console/exceptions -> View the exceptions list with severity filtering
Navigate to /exceptions/[id] -> Open an exception record -> See the exception detail page
Navigate to /exceptions/[id] -> Enter resolution text -> Mark the exception resolved -> See the resolved state
Navigate to /exceptions/[id] -> Reopen a previously resolved exception -> See the resolution form hidden when re-resolve is blocked

features.name: Barcode Scanning Console
features.description: Staff can use the camera scanner to decode barcodes, accept or reject scans, and monitor the scan log.
user_flows: Navigate to /ops-console/scanning -> Allow camera access -> See the live scanner viewfinder
Navigate to /ops-console/scanning -> Point the camera at a barcode -> See the code decoded in real time
Navigate to /ops-console/scanning -> Accept a decoded scan -> See the ok counter increase
Navigate to /ops-console/scanning -> Reject a decoded scan -> See the err counter increase
Navigate to /ops-console/scanning -> Review the scan log -> See recent scan activity

features.name: Settings and Integrations
features.description: Staff can update profile details and manage API keys and webhook subscriptions.
user_flows: Navigate to /ops-console/settings -> Update email, display name, or hub code -> Save changes -> See the updated profile summary
Navigate to /ops-console/settings -> Open the API Keys section -> Issue a new key -> Copy it -> Revoke it later if needed
Navigate to /ops-console/settings -> Open the Webhooks section -> Add a subscription -> Review delivery logs
Navigate to /ops-console/settings -> Open the integrations shortcuts -> Jump to API keys or webhooks management pages

features.name: Hub Management
features.description: Super admins can view, create, edit, and activate or deactivate hubs used across operational flows.
user_flows: Navigate to /ops-console/management -> View the hubs table with names, codes, and active state
Navigate to /ops-console/management -> Add a new hub -> Save hub details -> See the hub added to the list
Navigate to /ops-console/management -> Edit a hub -> Save changes -> See the updated hub information
Navigate to /ops-console/management -> Toggle hub active state -> See the active status change

features.name: Public Shipment Tracking
features.description: Anyone can track a shipment by entering an AWB and viewing public status information, ETA, and events.
user_flows: Navigate to /track -> Enter an AWB -> Submit tracking request -> See the tracking results page
Navigate to /track/[awb] -> View shipment status -> View estimated delivery -> View tracking events timeline
Navigate to /track/[awb] -> Review the event history -> See the shipment progression over time

tech_stack: TailwindCSS v4 with semantic tokens (Violet Grid v6 + Paper Ops Console)
Radix UI primitives + shadcn (zero-radius design system)

routes.description: Email/password sign-in via Supabase Auth with magic-link fallback

Multi-step invoice wizard (customer + AWB autofill + rate lookup + line items + preview + autosave)
Customers list with revenue + shipment count

Exception detail with resolution textarea (paper detail redirects here)

Profile + Integrations card linking to API keys + Webhooks

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Email/password sign-in via Supabase, session refresh middleware, sign-in redirect with next param, sign-out, rate-limited auth surface (Upstash)
user_interactions: Enter email + password
Click Sign In
On invalid credentials see inline error
On success redirect to /ops-console (or to ?next= if provided)
From any protected route, redirect to /sign-in?next=<original>
Sign out from user menu

features.name: Paper Ops Console Dashboard
features.description: Mission-control dashboard with banner image, 3 KPI stat cards, Command Center quick actions, Growth/Shipment Volume/Upcoming Ops cards
user_interactions: View banner image with DISPATCH · LIVE pulse pill
Click "Active Shipments" stat card → /ops-console/shipments?status=active
Click "In Transit" stat card → /ops-console/shipments?status=in_transit
Click "Open Exceptions" stat card → /ops-console/exceptions
Click "+ Shipment" → /shipments/create
Click "+ Manifest" → /manifests/create
Use sidebar nav (Platform / Operations / Business / Audit & Reports)
C/M/S theme toggle in topbar

features.name: Shipment CRUD + Tracking
features.description: Create shipment (4-step wizard with auto AWB), view detail with status stepper + tracking events + barcode + print label, list with status tabs + AWB search
user_interactions: View shipments table with AWB / customer / route / status / age columns
Filter by tab (All / Created / In Transit / Out for Delivery / Delivered / Exception)
Search by AWB / sender / receiver
Click "+ New Shipment" → wizard
Fill 4-step wizard (sender → receiver → package → review)
Submit creates AWB and redirects to detail
On detail click "Back to Shipments" → list
Switch detail tabs (Overview / Tracking / Notes / Files / Audit)
View status stepper (CREATED → PICKUP → ... → DELIVERED)
Print thermal label (/print/label/[awb])
Click View in list row → detail

features.name: Manifest Builder + State Machine
features.description: 3-step manifest wizard (setup hub + transport + flight/vehicle | add shipments by AWB scan loop | review + close), detail with close→depart→arrive→reconcile state machine + inline AWB scan
user_interactions: View manifests list with status filter (Draft / Building / Open / Closed / Departed / Arrived)
Click "+ New Manifest" → wizard
Step 1 Setup - Select From Hub + To Hub combobox, choose AIR or TRUCK, fill flight/vehicle details, optional notes
Step 2 Add Shipments - scan or enter AWBs to attach, see SUCCESS/DUPLICATE/ERROR feedback per row
Step 3 Review - see loadlist count + total weight, Save Open or Close+Depart
On detail view loadlist + total pieces/weight
Action bar surfaces NEXT_ACTION based on status (Close Manifest / Mark Departed / Mark Arrived / Reconcile)
Add AWB inline on Open/Draft manifests
Empty hubs state shows "Go to Hub Management" CTA (regression fix)

features.name: Invoice + Finance Flows
features.description: Multistep invoice wizard with autosave + rate lookup, detail with WhatsApp send (kill-switch aware) + payment recording (handles PaymentResponseLost) + PDF/label print + state transitions (Issue/Mark Paid/Cancel)
user_interactions: View invoices list with aging buckets card row + invoices table
Filter by status tab (All / Draft / Issued / Paid / Overdue)
Click "+ New Invoice" → v6 multistep wizard
On detail click Preview / Print&PDF / Label print routes
Click WhatsApp button (disabled when kill-switch off or upstream down)
Open WhatsApp dialog, choose direct vs template mode, send, see WAMID
Click Record Payment, fill amount + method + reference, submit
Handle PaymentResponseLost - warning toast says verify before retry (no duplicate)
Click Mark Fully Paid (only on ISSUED)
Click Cancel (only on DRAFT/ISSUED)
View payment timeline + delete payment with confirm

user_interactions: View customers list (paper)
Open detail (paper redirects to v6 detail at /customers/[id])
Click Edit toggle, modify fields, Save Changes
Switch detail tabs (Overview / Shipments / Notes)
Add Note via TipTap editor, see in timeline

Open detail (paper redirects to v6)
Type resolution text in textarea

features.name: Barcode Scanning

user_interactions: Allow camera permission
Point camera at barcode, see decode in real time
Accept/reject scans
View scan log + ok/err counters

user_interactions: Update email + display name + hub code
Click Save Changes
See profile completion percentage

Click Webhooks → /settings/webhooks

features.name: Hub Management

user_interactions: View hubs table with name + code + active toggle
Add new hub
Edit hub details
Toggle active

features.name: Public Tracking
features.description: Public AWB tracking page (no auth required)
user_interactions: Enter AWB on /track
Click Track → /track/[awb]
See status + estimated delivery + tracking events timeline

known_limitations.issue: Paper variants of multistep wizards (invoice/manifest create) are simplified — the "+ New" buttons route operators to the full v6 wizards. Dormant paper variant code exists at /ops-console/<resource>/create.
known_limitations.impact: No operator harm — the v6 wizards are reachable and full-featured. Paper variants will be ported in a future sprint.

known_limitations.issue: Customer + exception paper detail routes redirect to v6 detail pages because the simplified paper versions dropped Edit form / Notes thread / resolution textarea functionality.
known_limitations.impact: Operators get full feature surface, but the route briefly redirects between paper and v6 chrome.

known_limitations.issue: Manifest builder requires hubs to be seeded. If hubs table is empty the Combobox shows "No results." Now mitigated with empty-state CTA pointing to /management.
known_limitations.impact: Fresh installs need at least 2 hubs before manifests work.

known_limitations.issue: Live corridor map status colors resolve from CSS custom properties via runtime hook (useCssVars) because MapLibre WebGL cannot read CSS vars directly.
known_limitations.impact: None — colors now match brand violet/red/green/taupe and re-resolve on theme switch.

known_limitations.issue: Some v6 routes (home/, bookings/) intentionally retained for v6 chrome navigation continuity. Full v6 sunset is a separate refactor.
known_limitations.impact: v6 chrome still anchors at /home; proxy redirects external /home to /ops-console.
